title: Delegates arrive for 49th ASEAN Summit at PICC
summary: Delegates of the Associate of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) on Sunday have begun arriving for the 49th ASEAN Summit at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) in Pasay City.

blocks.text: Delegates of the 49th Associate of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit on Sunday have begun arriving at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) in Pasay City.

The various delegations started arriving at around 8:30 a.m. and were received by President Ferdinand Marcos and First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos at the PICC for the opening ceremony that marks the beginning of the four-day Summit, which will run from November 15 to 18.

items: Director-General U Han Win Aung, Myanmar representative
Dr. Hang Chuon Naron, deputy Prime Minister of Cambodia
Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith and Madame Alouny Kommasith of Lao People's Democratic Republic
Prime Minister Dato' Seri Anwar Ibrahim and Dato' Seri Dr. Wan Izah Dr. Wan Ismail of Malaysia
